versions.content: Merging of splitable elements from partial models The following rules apply for the merging of splitable elements from partial models: – If the upper multiplicity of a splitable property in the variant-rich model is > 1, then M1 elements with the same identity according to [TPS_GST_00047] are merged. M1 Elements with different identity or without identity are not merged, i.e. they are just copied to the output collection. – If the upper multiplicity of a splitable property in the varaint-rich model is 1, then M1 elements with different identity lead to a multiplicity conflict. M1 elements with the same identity according to [TPS_GST_00047] or without identity are merged. After binding the variation, the multiplicities shall match the multiplicities of the pure meta model.
